source_exhaustion_gate.stopping_rule: For every source family, complete two consecutive query waves that add no new qualifying incident lineage.
source_exhaustion_gate.reason: The two recorded GitHub saturation waves still added 266 and 198 normalized source rows respectively. GitHub search result caps, Reddit archive timeouts, limited X indexing, and the bounded Hugging Face model listing prevent an honest claim of full source exhaustion. The corpus is large and source-diverse, but it is not a census of every discoverable web record.

huggingface_model_uploads.known_limit: Model enumeration used a bounded recent/popular listing per provider, not every historical upload.

github_supply_chain.known_limit: GitHub search returns at most 1000 results per query and only the first 100 results were captured for several high-volume queries. Reply text was recovered for the foundational incidents but not for every added issue; comment and reaction counts remain attention signals only.

reddit.known_limit: The Arctic Shift full-text endpoint timed out or rate-limited broad query windows. Successful annual slices and direct conversation retrieval are preserved; failed queries are recorded in reddit_candidates.json.

hacker_news.known_limit: Algolia search covers indexed public HN stories and comments only.

x_twitter.known_limit: Public web and mirror indexes exposed the seed thread, one reply, and a few standalone reports. X replies and private or unindexed posts are not exhaustively searchable without authenticated archive access.

controlled_studies_and_official_docs.known_limit: Controlled studies were selected for explicit failure regimes and mechanism contact, not every compression paper published in the window.

unavailable_or_unmined.private_discord_and_slack: No public, lawful index or credentials were available.
unavailable_or_unmined.stack_overflow_and_stack_exchange: Mapped in the source universe but no qualifying records were added in this pass.
unavailable_or_unmined.public_discourse_archives: Mapped in the source universe but no query-complete archive was available in this pass.
unavailable_or_unmined.model_download_history: Current download counts were captured where exposed; historical rolling counts are unavailable.
